description: This file defines the ContentModeration class for Drupal, implementing a workflow type plugin that manages content moderation states and their associated logic, including dependency management and initial state determination.

classes.name: ContentModeration
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that attaches workflows to content entity types and their bundles, managing states, dependencies, and initial state logic for content moderation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ContentModeration object with necessary services.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a moderation state object, wrapping parent state with additional configuration.

methods.name: workflowHasData
methods.description: Checks if the given workflow has associated moderation state data.

methods.name: workflowStateHasData
methods.description: Checks if a specific state within a workflow has associated moderation data.

methods.name: getEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of entity types configured for moderation.

methods.name: getBundlesForEntityType
methods.description: Returns bundles associated with a specific entity type.

methods.name: appliesToEntityTypeAndBundle
methods.description: Determines if the workflow applies to a specific entity type and bundle.

methods.name: removeEntityTypeAndBundle
methods.description: Removes a specific entity type and bundle from the configuration.

methods.name: addEntityTypeAndBundle
methods.description: Adds an entity type and bundle to the configuration.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the workflow, including states and transitions.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies based on entity types and bundles.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles cleanup when dependencies are removed, such as entity types, bundles, or modules.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration, ensuring states and entity types are ordered.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Determines the initial moderation state for a given content entity based on its publishing status.
